name: mentingo
description: Open-source AI-native LMS with AI Mentor & role-play. Self-hosted alternative to Moodle, Docebo, TalentLMS, Thinkific, Teachable and Open edX.

paragraphs: Mentingo is an open-source, self-hosted learning management system (LMS) with a built-in AI mentor, built for corporate L&D, employee onboarding and compliance training.
MIT-licensed, white-label and multi-tenant - run it on your own infrastructure, brand it as your own, and keep every learner record inside your organisation.
Live demo · Quick start · Deploy on AWS · Features · Security & compliance · FAQ · Docs · Commercial support
features: Practise conversations instead of watching slides. A voice and chat AI mentor runs real-time role-play for sales, compliance and customer-support scenarios, and scores the attempt automatically.
Turn the documents you already have into a course. The AI course architect converts knowledge bases, policies and internal documentation into structured, interactive courses in minutes.
Grade open-ended answers without an L&D queue. Behavioural and problem-solving tasks are analysed automatically and returned with actionable feedback.
Keep the AI accountable. Every model call is traced with Langfuse, so you can inspect cost, latency and what the mentor actually said.
Ship it as your own product. Custom domains, logos, colours and styles - no Mentingo branding required anywhere in the learner experience.

requirements.text: You configure the AI provider and its API key.
You configure the provider and supply your own API key - OpenAI is supported out of the box through the Vercel AI SDK.
Mentingo is free to self-host under the MIT licence, and it is maintained by Selleo - a product engineering team that has been building learning platforms since 2005.
